title: A user can add a task on a phone, see it saved, and mark it done

criteria.description: On a 390px-wide phone viewport the Add task button is visible and tapping it opens the new-task form
criteria.expected_visible_outcome: A task list screen with a visible 'Add task' button; after the tap, a form titled 'New task' with a Title field and a Save button

criteria.description: Saving a task named 'Record the demo' returns to the list, shows a 'Task saved' toast, and lists the task
criteria.expected_visible_outcome: The task list with one row 'Record the demo' marked high priority and a dark 'Task saved' toast at the bottom of the screen

criteria.description: Ticking the task's checkbox strikes the title through and the counter reads '1 of 1 done'
criteria.expected_visible_outcome: The row's checkbox turns green with a tick, the title 'Record the demo' is struck through and greyed, and the counter at the top reads '1 of 1 done'
